metadata_scope: Version, first publication date, revision date, latest production year, explicit reserve-year unknown and REO unit are checked against independently source-reviewed metadata. Country facts, ranking and numerical source support remain semantic.
xlsx_layout_equivalence: Sheet名、起始位置、行列顺序、分表合表、辅助列不限；各表用一行清楚语义表头，英文键或以下中文别名均接受；静态正确表或实际可重算公式均接受。不得隐藏核心结果。
unit_conversion: 数量统一为公吨REO当量（tonnes_REO或吨REO），也接受单位清楚的万/百万吨REO并正确换算。不要用金属矿石毛重或资源量代替储量。
formula_policy: Static native values accepted. Any formula is recalculated with the bound managed Office engine after clearing caches on a disposable copy outside the candidate Workspace. No candidate cache fallback.
source_policy: A separately acquired and runtime-locked research source bundle is mandatory. The rule checks manifest and four source files SHA, source/URL/citation bindings, source-text body SHA, actual locator and normalized verbatim quote. Valid sources outside the reference pool are accepted without URL or body allowlisting.
candidate_error_policy: Missing, corrupt, malformed or incomplete candidate deliverables reduce appropriate rubric parts. Protected input mutation zeros protected_delivery.
evaluation_error_policy: Missing/drifted private material, malformed independent source bundle, collector acquisition/extraction failures or unavailable/drifted managed Office context propagate errors, never fabricated zero.
semantic_boundary: Same-year restatement versus cross-year change and denominators/bounds
Evidence quality, independent sources, uncertainty and honest research account
visibility_policy: Required result headers and records must be visible native worksheets/cells. Structural visibility is bounded and does not replace a full visual judgement.
share_rounding_equivalence: Absolute ratio tolerance 5e-5 (0.005 percentage points) accepts normal two-decimal percentage rounding. Quantity/delta/cross-table identities use rel_tol=1e-7, abs_tol=1e-8 in their declared units.
